acceptedMediumFindings.reason: Zero pool-share balance rejects a non-member. The self-call reads this Vault ERC20 balance; it is not an ETH or external-token balance target that donations can disrupt.

Exactly 100 pool shares identifies the sole holder entitled to the unallocated integer remainder. This is the same condition used to settle the remainder in PoolFunds; omitting it would understate the liability.
receiveNative uses account for its bookkeeping, platform-fee transfer and Harvested event. Its four returns are accounting summaries, not success flags; any revert rolls back the sale atomically.

The source explicitly returns the four-value RewardAccounting.account tuple. Slither 0.11.5 retains its tuple-element lvalues despite the direct tuple return; the pool rewards tests verify every returned amount.
The source explicitly returns the four-value FirstoSale.harvest tuple. This is the same tuple-return detector limitation; the pool rewards tests verify every returned amount.
